verdict.rationale: Medusa's pricing page lists "Data sovereignty" and "BYOC with Enterprise License", so the product itself claims some control over where data lives, including running in your own cloud. These are only bare line items: no region list, selection mechanism, or residency guarantees are documented, and BYOC appears tied to an Enterprise license. missing for 10: documented region/residency selection options for Medusa Cloud, details of what "data sovereignty" covers, availability outside the Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
